key_insight: A mixture-of-experts framework with generative diffusion models can generalize physical layer security strategies across diverse wireless scenarios instead of retraining for each one.
engineering_relevance: This offers a practical 6G security tool for adaptive beamforming with artificial noise that can maintain strong secrecy under changing channel conditions.
method: Select representative scenarios and train scenario-specific GDM experts for secure beamforming.
Use a lightweight gating network to infer the scenario from channel features and choose the top experts.
Fuse expert outputs with an attention-based combiner to produce the final security strategy.
evidence_signal: Simulations in the abstract indicate the method can recognize scenarios, select experts correctly, and achieve near-optimal secrecy rates across a range of wireless scenarios.
watch_item: Performance may depend on how representative the chosen training scenarios are and on reliable channel-feature extraction for gating.
paper_title: Unlocking Cross-Scenario Physical Layer Security: A Mixture-of-Experts Framework with Generative Diffusion Models
